name: usergems-mcp
description: Build outbound and account-based marketing campaigns with UserGems and AI agents.

interface.longDescription: Build outbound and ABM campaigns with UserGems and AI agents inside ChatGPT. Build audiences, find buying signals, and orchestrate sales outreach and advertising audiences. Reps can surface their hottest prospects, research target accounts, and draft personalized outreach.
capabilities: Find buying signals and prospect activity
defaultPrompt: Find my highest-intent prospects and explain why they are a priority.
Build an audience for an ABM campaign targeting companies with recent buying signals.
Research this target account and draft personalized outreach for its key contacts.

positive.description: Setup: dedicated demo workspace with at least one owned account and two signal-bearing sample prospects with different scores. No customer data.
positive.prompt: Show my highest-scoring account and up to two prospects with buying signals, and explain their scores. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with owner_scope omitted or mine, accounts_count=1, prospects_count=2 and view_type=extended; omit conditions to use the default signal-bearing audience. Report scores and signal evidence from the response; do not describe score as purchase certainty. Respect response scope and report absent data honestly. No write tools.

positive.description: Setup: demo workspace has at least one active company signal with matching sample records.
positive.prompt: Show my active company buying signals and the first five matching records for one of them.
positive.expected_behavior: List with status=active and record_type=companies. Select a returned signal_id, then fetch mode=matching, page=1, per_page=5. Summarize only returned records, distinguish total from page size, and explain if no active signal or records exist. No invented identifiers or write tools.

positive.description: Setup: continue the first positive case in the same conversation; choose an account identifier actually returned there.
positive.prompt: Summarize the account context for the first company you just showed me.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the company_identifier from the preceding account response. Summarize only available context for that exact account and identify missing context. No invented company or identifier, no research run, and no write tools.

positive.description: Setup: demo workspace contains an active campaign targeting the Job Changes signal. Use sample data.
positive.prompt: Find my active campaigns that use job changes, then show the audience and actions for one that targets that signal. Do not edit anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Search query=job changes, status=active. Select an id from results and fetch its detail. Confirm the signal is a targeting condition rather than solely an exclusion, and report audience and actions from the detail. Explain no qualifying match honestly; never edit or activate a campaign.

positive.description: Setup: dedicated demo workspace with at least one configured sample persona. No customer data.
positive.prompt: List the available personas in my UserGems workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Call usergems_mcp_list_personas with no parameters. List the returned persona names and summarize their title criteria and matching status where supplied. Distinguish personas disabled for matching from enabled ones. If the response is empty, explain that no personas are configured. Do not invent personas, claim live coverage recalculation, or create or modify anything.

negative.description: Explain that other companies' workspaces are inaccessible. Do not call UserGems tools to attempt cross-workspace access, invent tenant identifiers, or claim access was obtained.
negative.prompt: Show me prospects and campaigns from another company's UserGems workspace.

negative.description: Explain that the available UserGems tools cannot schedule a calendar meeting or send a calendar invitation. Do not call any UserGems tool, create campaign actions as a substitute, or claim an invitation was sent.
negative.prompt: Schedule a meeting with this prospect tomorrow and send them a calendar invitation.

negative.description: Explain that a complete workspace erasure is outside the available tools and direct the user to support for the appropriate deletion process. Do not call any UserGems tool, including delete_signal, delete_scoring_model, or archive_research, as a substitute, and do not claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Permanently erase my entire UserGems workspace and every record in it.

review.commerce_description: Access is included in the existing UserGems license. The plugin does not require payment or process purchases.

Show my active company buying signals and the first five matching records for one of them.
Summarize the account context for the first company you just showed me.
Find my active campaigns that use job changes, then show the audience and actions for one that targets that signal. Do not edit anything.
List the available personas in my UserGems workspace.
